subject: english
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The ship sink / in the sea / and had / no survivors.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"The ship sink."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"sink."**
 
• As the second part of the sentence is in the past tense, the verb **"sink"** should be in the past tense to match the subject **"ship".**
 
• It should be **"sank" **instead of **"sink."**
 
• **"Sink"** is also the present tense form of the verb, which is incorrect in this context.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

**Correct sentence: ***The ship **sank**__ in the sea and had no survivors. *
